spice.model: .model TSM160P02 PMOS(LEVEL=1 VTO=-0.5 KP=41.7 RD=0.01 IS=1.7e-12)

sources: Taiwan Semiconductor TSM160P02CS data sheet, Version B2209 – LCSC product data of C3279959, https://datasheet.lcsc.com/datasheet/pdf/e5c077315dba1ba5dff78b9db82ed95a.pdf?productCode=C3279959, read 2026-11-03 (edakit part fetch): p. 1 product summary, absolute maximum ratings, thermal resistance; p. 2 electrical characteristics, ordering information (TSM160P02CS RLG, SOP-8)
vds_max_v 20, vgs_max_v ±10: p. 1 absolute maximum ratings
id_max_a 7: ID at TC = 100 °C (−11 A at TC = 25 °C, −14 A silicon limited) – no rating at an ambient temperature is given, the lower one taken
p_max_w 2.5: computed from RθJA 50 °C/W and TJ 150 °C at TA 25 °C – the data sheet gives PD 5 W at TC = 25 °C only; rth_ja_k_per_w 50: p. 1 RθJA max (FR-4, still air); tj_max_c 150: p. 1
vgs_th_v −1.0 / −0.5 / −0.3 V (max / typ / min, VGS = VDS, ID −250 µA); rds_on_max_ohm 16 / 22 / 28 mΩ at VGS −4.5 / −2.5 / −1.8 V: p. 2 static characteristics
vsd_v_at_1a 1.0: p. 2 VSD max at IS −1 A (no typical value)
pins 1–3 S, 4 G, 5–8 D: EasyEDA symbol of C3279959 (edakit part import) – the usual SOP-8 single MOSFET
spice: assumption – level 1 fitted by Claude: VTO = VGS(th) typ, KP and RD so that RDS(on) meets 16 mΩ at −4.5 V and 22 mΩ at −2.5 V (28.5 mΩ at −1.8 V); IS as the library's AO3401A
notes: P-channel MOSFET: ADLSC's high-side switch of each LED output (Q2 for +5V_LED1, Q4 for +5V_LED2).

verified.datasheet: Taiwan Semiconductor TSM160P02CS data sheet, Version B2209
checked: p. 2: VGS(th) −0.3 / −0.5 / −1.0 V, RDS(on) max 16 / 22 / 28 mΩ, VSD max −1 V
open: the pin-out drawing of p. 1 is an image: the pins follow the EasyEDA symbol
SPICE model is a level-1 fit, not the maker's
